aboutUs.title: About Us

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.paragraph1: Founded in 2008 by a team of passionate Malagasy and French individuals, Show Me Mada was born from a simple dream: to share the exceptional beauty of Madagascar with the entire world.
ourStory.paragraph2: What started as a small local agency has today become one of the leading players in responsible tourism in Madagascar. Our secret? An intimate knowledge of the terrain, privileged relationships with local communities, and a contagious passion for our island.
ourStory.paragraph3: Every trip we organize is the result of our expertise accumulated over the years and our unwavering commitment to tourism that respects the environment and local populations.

Tours.title: Tours
Tours.subtitle: Ultimate Travel Experience

morondava.description: Discover the wonders of southern Madagascar with its paradise beaches, majestic baobabs and unique culture.
morondava.detailedDescription: Embark on an extraordinary adventure through the breathtaking landscapes of south-west Madagascar. This trip takes you from the highlands of the capital to the famous baobabs of Morondava, via the hot springs of Antsirabe and the unique geological formations of Miandrivazo. You will discover the richness of Malagasy culture, observe exceptional endemic wildlife and enjoy the most beautiful sunsets of the Indian Ocean.
highlights: Avenue of the Baobabs at sunset
Boat trip on the Tsiribihina river
Unspoiled beaches of the west coast

nosyBe.description: The perfume island awaits you with its white sand beaches, turquoise waters and magical sunsets. An authentic tropical paradise.
nosyBe.detailedDescription: Escape to the perfume island, a true jewel of the Indian Ocean. Nosy Be will charm you with its ylang-ylang plantations, dream beaches and exceptional marine biodiversity. Between lazing on paradise beaches, diving in crystal-clear waters and exploring the surrounding islets, this stay promises an unforgettable tropical experience in an unspoiled setting.

andasibe.description: Immerse yourself in the primary forest and discover Indri lemurs in their natural habitat. A unique experience at the heart of Malagasy biodiversity.
andasibe.detailedDescription: Set off to discover one of Madagascar's most beautiful national parks, a true biodiversity sanctuary. The primary forest of Andasibe-Mantadia is home to the island's largest lemur, the Indri indri, whose melodious song echoes through the forest. This immersive experience lets you observe many endemic species in their preserved natural habitat, while enjoying breathtaking mountain scenery.

destinations.title: Madagascar Destinations
destinations.heading: Discover the Big Island
destinations.intro: Madagascar, a miniature continent with breathtaking landscapes and biodiversity unique in the world. Explore our must-see destinations across the different regions of the island.

antananarivo.subtitle: The Capital
antananarivo.description: Historic capital perched on its hills. Discover the Queen's Palace, colorful markets and unique colonial architecture.

antsirabe.subtitle: The City of Waters
antsirabe.description: Colonial spa town renowned for its mineral waters and temperate climate. City of rickshaws and craftsmanship.

ampefy.subtitle: The Volcanic Lake
ampefy.description: Magnificent volcanic lake surrounded by green hills. The perfect destination for relaxation and water sports.

fianarantsoa.subtitle: City of Education
fianarantsoa.description: Intellectual capital of Madagascar with its historic old town and surrounding vineyards.

morondava.subtitle: Avenue of the Baobabs
morondava.description: Gateway to the Avenue of the Baobabs. Unforgettable sunsets over century-old baobabs and access to the Tsingy.

tsingy.subtitle: Stone Forest
tsingy.description: Spectacular UNESCO-listed limestone formations. A labyrinth of rocky peaks sheltering unique and exceptional wildlife.

bekopaka.subtitle: Gateway to the Tsingy
bekopaka.description: Authentic village serving as a base to explore the Tsingy. Meet the local Sakalava communities.

mahajanga.subtitle: Cosmopolitan City
mahajanga.description: Cosmopolitan port with Arab and Indian influences. Magnificent beaches and a sacred thousand-year-old baobab.

andasibe.subtitle: Lemur Forest
andasibe.description: National park home to Indri lemurs. Humid primary forest with exceptional biodiversity.

sainteMarie.subtitle: Whale Island
sainteMarie.description: Paradise island famous for humpback whale watching. White sand beaches and pirate history.

manakara.subtitle: End of the FCE Line
manakara.description: Terminus of the famous FCE train. Wild beaches and the Pangalanes canal with its fishing villages.

mananjary.subtitle: Pangalanes Canal
mananjary.description: Peaceful town crossed by the Pangalanes canal. A production center for Madagascar vanilla and spices.

nosyBe.subtitle: Perfume Island
nosyBe.description: Paradise tropical island famous for its ylang-ylang and white sand beaches. A wide range of water activities.

diego.subtitle: Antsiranana
diego.description: Magnificent bay and gateway to Montagne d'Ambre. Colonial architecture and unspoiled nature.

ambre.subtitle: National Park
ambre.description: Humid mountain forest with spectacular waterfalls. A unique tropical microclimate in northern Madagascar.

tulear.subtitle: Toliara
tulear.description: Gateway to the deep south of Madagascar. Several white sand beaches and the culture of the nomadic Vezo fishermen.

ifaty.subtitle: Fishing Village
ifaty.description: Vezo fishing village with an exceptional coral reef. Spiny forest and baobabs of southern Madagascar.

fortDauphin.subtitle: Tolagnaro
fortDauphin.description: Historic south-eastern town with magnificent beaches. Berenty Reserve and ring-tailed lemur watching.

isalo.subtitle: National Park
isalo.description: Sculpted sandstone massif with canyons, oases and natural pools. Spectacular landscapes of Madagascar's Wild West.

regionDescriptions.hauts_plateaux: Terraced rice fields, historic towns and a temperate climate in the heart of the island.
regionDescriptions.ouest: Giant baobabs, spectacular Tsingy and sunsets over the Mozambique Channel.
regionDescriptions.est: Tropical rainforests, lemurs and lagoons along the Pangalanes canal.
regionDescriptions.nord: Paradise islands, turquoise sea and lush national parks.
regionDescriptions.sud: Canyons, wild beaches and Vezo culture under the sun of the deep south.
